scope: previous 24 hours of verified portfolio evidence
sequence: rank active blockers from watchdog state
perform root-cause analysis from actual failure evidence
make one bounded smallest-safe repair attempt when authorized
if still blocked, park only the dependent lane and rotate to parallel-safe product work
record the lesson and prevention rule when verified
root_cause_rule: Never infer root cause from a red badge or blocker label. Use the first meaningful verified failure evidence; otherwise root cause is UNKNOWN.
success_condition: The daily review ends with either verified blocker reduction/removal or an exact next gate plus continued parallel-safe product advancement.
forbidden: passive daily status-only reporting when repairable evidence exists
project-wide parking caused by one dependent lane
letting daily orchestrator analysis replace hourly product execution
